title: 고준위 방사성폐기물 관리위원회 직제 / queue:ADDENDUM:35803:20251001:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Addenda to the Organization of the Ministry of Trade and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 35803, October 1, 2025>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. Provided, however, that amendments to Presidential Decrees made under Article 6 of these Addenda, which were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived, shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.
Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.
Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (5) Omitted.
(6) Part of the Organization of the High-Level Radioactive Waste Management Commission shall be amended as follows:
In Article 9 (3), "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy" shall be replaced with "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment".
(7) through (101) Omitted.
